evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/aml_dsa/moderation.rs:627-684 report_content (POST /moderation/report, wired in aml_dsa/mod.rs:88) is open to EVERY authenticated user (the handler comment itself notes 'This endpoint is open to every authenticated user'). It validates only reason length (validate_optional_text_field, MAX_REPORT_REASON_LEN) and resolves the content owner, then calls create_moderation_case.

backend/crates/db/src/repositories/compliance.rs:431-470 create_moderation_case does a blind INSERT INTO moderation_cases (...) with NO dedup/idempotency check — no lookup for an existing open/pending case on the same (content_type, content_id) and no per-reporter guard. aml_dsa/mod.rs router adds no limiting layer on /moderation/report.

Impact (medium, abuse/DoS + data-integrity): any authenticated tenant member can POST the same content_id repeatedly to create unbounded moderation_cases rows — flooding the moderator queue (get_moderation_queue), skewing get_moderation_stats, and bloating the table. Fix: add a unique/partial index or repo-side dedup, plus a per-user report rate limit.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/aml_dsa/moderation.rs:480-551 file_appeal checks ONLY content ownership (existing.content_owner_id == user.user_id) and org scoping; it does NOT check the case's current status before appealing.

backend/crates/db/src/repositories/compliance.rs:836-861 file_appeal issues UPDATE moderation_cases SET appeal_filed=TRUE, appeal_reason=$2, appeal_filed_at=NOW(), status='appealed' ... WHERE id=$1 AND organization_id=$3 — WHERE clause has NO status guard. So a case in ANY state (open/under_review, or one whose appeal was already decided via decide_appeal → appeal_upheld/appeal_rejected) is unconditionally flipped back to status='appealed'.

Impact (medium, state-machine / DSA appeal finality): a content owner can re-file an appeal repeatedly, including after a final decision, silently re-opening a closed case. Fix: gate file_appeal on an appealable status set (WHERE status IN (...) AND appeal_filed = FALSE) and return 409 CONFLICT otherwise.
